payload.friendly_name: docs/plans Closeout and Doctrine Schema Diagrams
payload.purpose_context: Following PR #3324's domain-throughline model, this mission completes the docs/plans working surface (retiring shipped/superseded plan clusters, authoring the packs-extraction and api-dashboard domain plans, and migrating the domain plans into a domains/ cluster) and enriches the doctrine documentation with PlantUML schema diagrams of agent-profiles, mission-types, the DRG, and other artefacts generated from the canonical code models so they never drift. It also adds local PlantUML rendering to the DocFX docsite as the prerequisite capability.
payload.purpose_tldr: Finish the docs/plans curation and give the doctrine artefacts code-grounded schema diagrams.
